gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: He suffers from ___ (SLEEP) since the accident.

gaps.explanation: 'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
